panel-title.purpose: Shape library and contextual property headings.

body.purpose: Regular editor content and property values.

metadata.purpose: Source revision, save status, hints, and counts.

motion.name: connection-handle-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal ports during hover, selection, and keyboard focus.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Shared command feedback; pressed feedback has no transition delay and reduced-motion removes transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Commit a local editor action such as adding a connection.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); border: 1px solid transparent; background: #0071e3; color: #fff; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #0066cc; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-primary:active { opacity: .75; transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet toolbar action; the pressed state identifies an active tool.
components.css: .ds-ghost { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); padding: 0 10px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #45484e; } .ds-ghost:hover { background: #00000008; } .ds-ghost[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #e8f2ff; color: #0066cc; } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-ghost:active { background: #dfe4eb; opacity: .75; transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-ghost:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ghost { transition: none; } }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary document action such as exporting or duplicating a shape.
components.css: .ds-outline { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); background: #fff; color: #45484e; border: 1px solid #c8cdd3; } .ds-outline:hover { border-color: hsl(220 5% 40% / .5); } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-outline:active { opacity: .75; transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-outline:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-outline { transition: none; } }

components.name: Property Field
components.description: Light inspector field for editable dimensions and document properties.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; width: 148px; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #45484e; font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-field-label span { color: #62666c; font-size: 10px; } .ds-field { width: 148px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid #c8cdd3; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #fff; color: #1d1d1f; font: 400 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; box-shadow: none; caret-color: #0071e3; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: hsl(210 100% 45% / .35); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: -2px; border-color: hsl(210 100% 45% / .7); } .ds-field:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-field { font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Command Bar
components.description: Grouped document commands above the drawing canvas.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 49px; padding: 2px 8px; background: #f5f5f7; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8dce1; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-toolbar-group { padding-right: 6px; border-right: 1px solid #d8dce1; } .ds-toolbar button { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #45484e; font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toolbar button:hover { background: #00000008; } .ds-toolbar button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-toolbar button:active { background: #dfe4eb; opacity: .75; } .ds-toolbar .ds-toolbar-active { background: #e8f2ff; color: #0066cc; } @media (max-width: 1050px) { .ds-toolbar { overflow-x: auto; } }

components.name: Shape Card
components.description: A labelled library shape that can be clicked or dragged into the canvas.
components.css: .ds-shape { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; width: 72px; height: 88px; padding: 10px 4px; border: 1px solid #d8dce1; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: #45484e; font: 400 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-shape:hover { background: #e8f2ff; border-color: #0071e3; } .ds-shape:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-shape:active { opacity: .75; } .ds-shape:disabled { opacity: .38; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-shape { width: auto; height: 48px; padding: 4px; flex-direction: row; gap: 5px; border: 0; font-size: 11px; } .ds-shape svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; } }

components.name: Saved Document Card
components.description: Open an account-local document from the saved-document dialog.
components.css: .ds-saved { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 68px; padding: 12px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(240 10% 96%); color: #1d1d1f; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-saved:hover { border-color: hsl(210 100% 45%); } .ds-saved:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(210 100% 45%); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-saved:active { opacity: .75; } .ds-saved:disabled { opacity: .5; } .ds-saved > svg { flex-shrink: 0; color: hsl(210 100% 45%); } .ds-saved > span:not(.ds-saved-check) { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; } .ds-saved strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-saved small { font-size: 11px; color: hsl(220 5% 40%); } .ds-saved-check { color: hsl(210 100% 45%); }

components.name: Selection Chip
components.description: Passive text feedback for the selected object or active connection task.
components.css: .ds-selection-chip { display: inline-block; color: #0066cc; background: #eef5ff; border: 1px solid #cddff8; border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px 8px; font: 400 11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; pointer-events: none; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-selection-chip { font-size: 10px; } }

narrative.overview:
The editor pairs the familiar draw.io workbench arrangement with the Apple-inspired light colors requested by the user. A quiet neutral frame holds the document controls, shape library, and status tools around a white drawing surface. Blue identifies actions, focus, and selection while the drawing itself remains the main content.

This record applies only to the diagram editor, its menus, and its saved-document and deletion dialogs. The surrounding AutoCheck website keeps its incumbent design. The record follows the implemented component and stylesheet rather than prescribing a new website identity.
keyCharacteristics: Light neutral tools around a white drawing canvas.
Compact system typography and explicit control labels.
A persistent shape library with contextual editing properties.
Direct movement, visible connection handles, and reversible edits.
Responsive tools that keep the drawing workspace usable on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Scoped Color Rule
rules.body: Apply editor colors to its portaled menus and dialogs as well as the embedded workbench; preserve the surrounding site's colors.

rules.name: The Contextual Properties Rule
rules.body: Reserve the inspector for the selected object or active connection task so the unselected canvas receives the available width.

dos: **Do** preserve the shape-library, canvas, and contextual-inspector arrangement.
**Do** use blue for actions, focus, and active editor controls while neutral surfaces carry structure.
**Do** theme portaled editor menus and dialogs alongside the embedded editor.
**Do** keep the white drawing surface and exported diagrams visually legible with the shared drawing-color helpers.
**Do** retain visible saved-state feedback and separate editable JSON backup instructions.
donts: **Don't** apply this scoped editor palette to the surrounding AutoCheck website.
**Don't** make the inspector a permanent empty column when there is no selected object or active connection task.
**Don't** rely on color alone for selected swatches, current saved documents, or disabled editing capability.
**Don't** remove the narrow-screen property pane or accessible command names when simplifying the toolbar.
